peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is ECCN Export Control Classification Number EAR99?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The Department of Commerce classifies the majority of commercial items as EAR99. EAR99 can be exported to all countries unless the export is going to a comprehensively-sanctioned country, a prohibited end-user/user of concern, or an Entity List or Unverified List organization, or is for a prohibited end-use.Feb 27, 2026
